entities.name: Fabian Gottlieb von der Osten-Sacken
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fabian Gottlieb Fürst von der Osten-Sacken was a field marshal in the Imperial Russian Army of Baltic German descent who led the army against the Duchy of Warsaw. He later governed Paris during the city's brief occupation by the anti-French coalition.
